question:
Match the dominant folk dance with the song-theme:

 
 

 **Folk dance**
 **Song-theme**
 
 
 
 

 **1. Panthi**
 **A.** Devotional hymns to Guru Ghasidas (Hari-Gaitri)
 
 

 **2. Gotipua**
 **B.** Krishna-Jagannath leela narratives
 
 

 **3. Kalbelia**
 **C.** Sensuous serpent metaphors
 
 

 **4. Tippani**
 **D.** Work-song pounding couplets (saathiyo re)
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 1: 1-A 2-B 3-C 4-D**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Panthi**: This folk dance is associated with **devotional hymns to Guru Ghasidas (Hari-Gaitri)**. It is performed by the Satnami community of Chhattisgarh and is deeply spiritual in nature.
 
• **Gotipua**: This traditional dance of Odisha narrates **Krishna-Jagannath leela**. It is performed by young boys dressed as females and is a precursor to the Odissi dance form.
 
• **Kalbelia**: The Kalbelia dance of Rajasthan uses **sensuous serpent metaphors** to mimic the movements of a snake, reflecting the community’s traditional association with snake charming.
 
• **Tippani**: This is a work-song dance from Gujarat that features **pounding couplets (saathiyo re)**. It is performed by women using long sticks to pound the ground in rhythm.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Panthi Dance:**

 
 
• It is a devotional dance form performed by the Satnami sect in Chhattisgarh.
 
• The dance is a tribute to Guru Ghasidas, who is revered as a spiritual leader and social reformer.
 
 
 
• **Gotipua Dance:**
 
 
• This dance form has been performed in Odisha since ancient times, often in temples to praise Lord Jagannath and Lord Krishna.
 
• Gotipua translates to “single boy,” as young boys dress up as female dancers for this performance.
 
 
 
• **Kalbelia Dance:**
 
 
• Performed by the Kalbelia community of Rajasthan, who were traditionally snake charmers.
 
• The dance involves intricate footwork and fluid movements that mimic the slithering of a snake.
 
 
 
• **Tippani Dance:**
 
 
• This folk dance originates from the Saurashtra region of Gujarat.
 
• Performed by women in groups, it is a work-oriented dance in which pounding sticks are used rhythmically to compact mud or clay.
